description: Newlines around a namespaced call's :: are ignored inside a heredoc interpolation
notes: The spec's function call grammar has a single identifier as the function name (FunctionCall = Identifier "(" arguments ")"), and :: is not one of its tokens. hashicorp/hcl accepts names separated by :: and reports them joined with :: as the function name (finishParsingFunctionCall in hclsyntax/parser.go). The spec says newlines are ignored inside parentheses, brackets, braces and function call arguments, but doesn't say so for interpolation sequences. hashicorp/hcl ignores newlines inside interpolations: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(false) before parsing the expression.
